judge.voice: Okay, this was meeting-shaped, finally: a supplier, a delivery date, no baby topics. Mara talked like a real sales manager, not slowly. It caught "we was" and the "since 2015" thing, and when I asked "why is that wrong?" the answer was one line and correct. I liked the recap with the "more better" fix. What I did not like: it stopped me twice in four replies, and I had to repeat myself like at school. It never told me why I am B1. Just "B1 · Getting by · self-chosen". For a man who says C1, that is arbitrary, so I would not accept it. It also missed "customer don't". Useful for the fixes, weak on proof. I would use it again, but I would not tell my director yet.
